unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She is in the kitchen.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她在厨房里。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 厨房里有只鸡（chicken）。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Jim's got a new kite.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 吉姆有了一个新风筝。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 风筝（kite）飞上天，k-i-t-e 像 纸鸢。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 膝；膝关节 `v.` 用膝盖顶(或撞)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My little brother, Sam, is on his knee.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我的小弟弟萨姆正跪在地上。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: k 不发音，nee 读如“尼”，用膝盖跪着。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 刀 `v.` 用刀伤害(或杀害)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Be careful when you use a sharp knife to cut the apple.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 用锋利的刀切苹果时要小心。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 刀 v. 用刀伤害(或杀害)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 敲；打，凿(洞) `n.` 敲击；敲门(或窗等)声
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Remember to knock at the door before entering the teacher's office.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 记得进老师办公室前先敲门。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：v. 敲；打，凿(洞) n. 敲击；敲门(或窗等)声。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 知道，知悉，了解；熟悉，认识 `n.` 知情
unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: But Sam knows nothing.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 但是萨姆什么也不知道。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: k(不发音) + now(现在)，现在你就知道了

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She has some knowledge of fashion.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她懂一些时尚知识。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：know（知道）演变而来的名词，-ledge为名词后缀，指“所知道的东西”，即“知识；学问”。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The cute koala spends most of its day sleeping in eucalyptus trees.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 这只可爱的考拉一天中的大部分时间都在桉树上睡觉。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 考拉；树袋熊。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Many foreign students come to China to learn traditional Chinese kung fu.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 许多外国学生来中国学习中国传统功夫。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 功夫(中国武术)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: We do interesting chemistry and physics experiments in the science lab.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我们在科学实验室里做有趣的化学和物理实验。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 实验室(=laboratory)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: An elderly lady got on the bus, and Jim offered her his seat.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 一位老妇人上了公交车，吉姆给她让了座。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. (pl. ladies) 女士；夫人；小姐。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The sea is blue, And the lake is too.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 大海是蓝色的，湖水也是蓝色的。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l + ake（蛋糕）-> 湖水像一块巨大的蓝蛋糕

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The little white lamb was skipping playfully across the green grass.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 小小白羊在绿草地上快活地蹦蹦跳跳。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 羔羊；羊羔肉。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: lamp
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 台灯
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 小灯(lamp)照亮小路(path)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 陆地；土地 `v.` 降落；着陆
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: The biggest land animal in the world is the African elephant.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 世界上最大的陆生动物是非洲象。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: 降落 (land) 在沙滩 (sand) 的土地上。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: as English Language Day.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 作为英语日。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: lan (懒) + guage (规矩) -> 懒人说话也有规矩，就形成了语言。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: During the Lantern Festival, red lanterns are hung along the streets.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 元宵节期间，街道两旁挂满了红灯笼。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 灯笼；提灯。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 笔记本电脑；便携式电脑
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: My father uses his laptop to send emails and write reports.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 我父亲用他的笔记本电脑发送电子邮件和写报告。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 笔记本电脑；便携式电脑。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: What's your new classroom like, Peter? It's large.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 彼得，你的新教室怎么样？它很大。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: l + ar (小车) + ge，大(large)车。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `det.` 最后的 `adv.` 最后 `n.` 最后来的人(或发生的事)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: December is the last month of the year.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 十二月是一年中的最后一个月。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：det. 最后的 adv. 最后 n. 最后来的人(或发生的事)。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Last Sunday I got up very late.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 上星期天我起床很晚。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 来特(late)快，可惜已经迟了(late)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `adv.` 后来；以后，随后 `adj.` 后来的
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Two days later, Liu Fei gets a big box.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 两天后，刘飞收到一个大箱子。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：late(迟的)+r -> 迟一点也就是之后，以后(later)。

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `n.` 笑声；大笑；嘲笑 `v.` 笑；大笑；嘲笑
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: He is really funny, and he often makes us laugh.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他真的很有趣，经常逗我们笑。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 拉夫(laugh)听到笑话哈哈大笑。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: She is going to study law at university.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 她打算在大学里学法律。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 罗（law）网无情，遵守法律

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Su Yan is going to study law to be a lawyer.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 苏妍打算学法律当一名律师。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: law（法律）+ yer = 懂法律的律师

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: They did not like him because he could not purr or lay eggs!
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 他们不喜欢他，因为他既不会发出呼噜声也不会下蛋！
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 谐音“累”：母鸡**下蛋**很累。

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Match each word with its opposite. fast shy late tall lazy loud funny
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 把每个词和它的反义词配对。快 害羞 晚 高 懒 吵闹 有趣
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆：la(拉)+zy(自愿)→拉他都不自愿动弹→“懒惰的”

unit_vocabulary.meaning: `v.` 领路；带领 `n.` 领先地位；主角
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Wang Shanghai led a group of 369 people who were determined to make the environment better.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 王上海带领着一群由369人组成的决心改善环境的团队。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 联想记忆: leader是领袖，动词是lead

unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: Tom was chosen as the team leader because he is responsible and friendly.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 汤姆被选为队长，因为他既负责又友好。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: 重点掌握中考核心释义：n. 领导者；领袖。

unit_vocabulary.syllable_type: 元音字母组合音节 (Vowel Team)
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence: In the afternoon, the farmer taught us how to cut branches and leaves from tomato plants.
unit_vocabulary.context_sentence_cn: 下午，农民教我们如何修剪西红柿植株的枝叶。
unit_vocabulary.memorization_hook: lea（累）+ f（飞）：叶子飞得很累。
